newsitem.title: USA: Global Pharma gets FDA nod on plant.
newsitem.headline: Global Pharma gets FDA nod on plant.

text.p: Global Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday it received written notification from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration that it was in compliance with the agency's current good manufacturing practices for production of drugs at its manufacturing plant here.
It said it will ship its first product, tetracycline hydrochloride 250 mg capsules, a broad spectrum antibiotic, by the end of the third quarter.

Max Mendelsohn, its president and chief executive, said the notification "is a major milestone...that will allow us to initiate our business plan...to make and market prescription and over-the-counter drugs."
It also said it expects to introduce a number of new generic drugs which it has been developing with strategic partners.
Global Pharmaceutical manufactures and sells solid, oral generic prescription and OTC drug products.
